Policy: these files are used only by the user-run CP/MVA disk installer,
M140 FDC diagnostic builder and host tests. They are never compiled into, linked into, or packaged with a
vaeg executable or release archive. The stock .cim binaries are not imported;
tools/cpmva rebuilds them from these sources with z80asm 1.8 and verifies the
result against the stock binary hashes above.

The stock files were copied byte-for-byte from the URLs above and were not edited.
